subject: Error in GPA analysis for sliding landmarks

messages.author: 5f1957cb9553c863
messages.subject: Error in GPA analysis for sliding landmarks
parts:
I have been attempting to carry out a GPA analysis on my data. It is a 3D array made up of 9 specimens with 59 landmarks. These landmarks were digitised using TPSdig curve tool to draw around my specimen and then converted from curvepoints to landmarks using TPSutil.  I have made all the landmarks sliding landmarks using Geomorph and have imported the csv file (read.csv("curveslide.csv", header = TRUE)). But none of the methods I can find online work to carry out my GPA analysis are working, I keep receiving errors like this no matter what method I try:
> mydata$curvepts
Error in mydata$curvepts : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
> humerus.gpa <- gpagen(mydata$land,curves=mydata$curvepts)
Error in mydata$land : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

I can't find any information on why or what has gone wrong so hopefully I can get some answer here! 

Cheers in advance!
